items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: Two brothers played the piano and two played the violin. Which two played the piano? Joe and John, and Roy and I played the violin.

ctx.x: Well, that was Joe, which is the oldest. And Roy's second, John third, and then on fourth. And H. Was your father? Father started the business in 1895. And built the first excursion boat that was used exclusively for one-day excursions, the steamer JS, built in 1903. And at that time, it was run on the upper Mississippi River and came to New Orleans and ran harbor trips for the first time in 1903.

And you personally, how long have you been aboard these boats? Ever since I was out of school. Ever since I was out of school. Of course, while I was in school, I was on them each summer. I made the summers on the boats. Do you mind if I ask your exact age? 65. And what is your birthday? July 27th. July 27th. So that would make you go on in 1895. 1895. 1895. See?
